reproductionNotes: The completed 231 route observations used the initial networkidle readiness protocol. The retained sweep-run script is the later resumable DOM-ready variant and was not used to regenerate the already-completed231 rows.

The control audit preserved130 completed rows, then continued with DOM readiness. Owned-process interruption produced recorded browser-closed failures; they are retained but excluded as product failures.
The two-second control timeouts are exploration limits, not latency acceptance thresholds. The profile-cover pointer interception was separately reproduced at1440px and390px with exact hit geometry.
Topic’s missing Promise params was a scratch harness defect, corrected only in the focused bundle. Its original render failures are excluded from product findings.
Beforeunload dismissal during harness reset prevented several Profile control probes; those are coverage gaps, not app navigation failures.
Studio disclosure exits occasionally matched an outside Edit control under a modal; those click timeouts are harness-only. Existing CI tests separately cover dialog flows.
